name: Johnson County, TX
findings: Johnson County has 429 nonprofit organizations. 147 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 109 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Johnson County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 35 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Johnson County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Few education organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 1 education organization here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 5 would.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through education groups? Where else does that happen?
